meta.title: Mood to Color — framework
meta.purpose: Map mood / emotion / abstract adjectives to curated palettes (Mindful Palettes, future Pinterest pins) using explicit axes + evidence-based bibliography. Not deterministic psychology: culture, medium, and brand context change readings (see NN/g + Color Palette Studio notes).

warmCool.description: +1 warmer (red–orange–yellow emphasis), −1 cooler (cyan–blue–violet). Derived from palette mean hue using cosine projection vs 180° (approximate R–B emotional axis in Western color education, per Figma color-theory + RMCAD framings).

arousal.description: Chromatic energy + contrast proxy (mean saturation, lightness spread). High arousal aligns with energetic / urgent brief language (Smartpress, Instapage).

valence.description: Rough hedonic tone: lighter, higher-chroma palettes skew positive; deep muted skew somber. Use as weak prior — verify with copy and imagery (NN/g).

sophistication.description: Restraint vs playfulness: low saturation + controlled contrast reads more luxe/editorial (Adobe discover + LA Film / RMCAD discussions).

grounding.description: Earth / organic bias (hues around yellow–green–brown + muted chroma), relevant to Stoneside spatial palettes + natural brands.

openness.description: Airiness / openness to variation: higher mean lightness + moderate spread (friendly SaaS vs dense luxury).

matchingRules.hueKernel: Gaussian on circular degrees: exp(-0.5 * (min_dtheta/sigma)^2) where min_dtheta is shortest arc on [0,360).
matchingRules.axisSimilarity: For each axis a in lexicon L and palette P: sim_a = 1 - min(1, |L_a - P_a| / span_a). Missing L_a treated as 0 weight for that term.
matchingRules.textBoost: Tokenize user query + paletteSummary (lowercase). +0.08 per exact lemma hit in summary (cap 0.24) to reward author language (Mindful Palettes captions).
disclaimers: Associations are culturally situated; marketing color tables are heuristics, not laws (ColorPsychology.org, Color Meanings, NN/g).
Palette psychology > isolated swatch psychology (Color Palette Studio).
Accessibility and legibility still override mood fit (NN/g, Figma systems thinking).
